facts.fact: Finlay 大笑承认这是头一回接触通灵解读，自称「彻底的新手」。
facts.anchor: ‘You caught me. First time doing anything like this. A total virgin.’

facts.fact: 童年起她说自己有问题从没人当真：家人、朋友、前男友都不信——因为她「看起来不像在受苦」。
facts.anchor: nobody has ever taken me seriously. Not family. Not friends. Definitely not past boyfriends. And all because I don’t look like I’m suffering.

facts.fact: 连她最好的朋友也在不久前断联消失。
facts.anchor: Even my best friend ghosted me a while back.

facts.fact: 她命令自己止住眼泪：你是 Nova，Nova 不哭。
facts.anchor: You’re Nova, remember? Nova doesn’t cry.

facts.fact: 「你想走我完全理解」是谎话——他真要走，她觉得自己能像考拉一样挂上他的腿。
facts.anchor: A lie, of course. That’s the last thing I want. I could see myself clinging onto his legs like a koala if he tried to.

facts.fact: 他单手拎椅挪到她身边时，脑内女声直接吼「快跑」——她捂住耳朵，发誓屋里像有第三个人。
她认定 Finlay 唤醒了她体内强大的力量——命中注定、她等的就是这个人。
facts.anchor: And Finlay Munro has been the one to finally awaken something truly powerful within me.

facts.fact: 桌中央她刚买的玫瑰石英「爱之水晶」——她断定这不是巧合。
facts.anchor: It can’t be just a coincidence that I recently bought the crystal of love.
